title: Challenge 7 Quiz - Building and Evaluating an RWA Project

questions.question: What is the first step when designing an RWA project?
options: List the tokens on an exchange

questions.question: A project's business model primarily explains:
options: How it creates, delivers and captures value

questions.question: Which of the following may serve as a revenue source for a tokenized real estate project?
Which factor is most important when evaluating an RWA project?
options: The existence and verification of the underlying asset
The color of the project's logo
The number of social media followers

questions.question: Which of the following is considered a warning sign?
Why do institutions explore RWA tokenization?
options: To replace every traditional bank immediately

questions.question: Which industry is actively exploring Real-World Asset tokenization?
Which principle is essential for long-term institutional adoption?
Why is continuous education important in the RWA industry?
options: Because regulations, technology and markets continue to evolve

questions.question: Which statement best summarizes a successful RWA project?
options: It combines strong legal structures, responsible governance, secure technology and sustainable business operations.
